title: Scenario cards: an explicit origin marker (generic / customer-derived / held-out) and a zh+en title, so the gallery exporter can export anything
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2ebbZkr2QAEG1x7UC8

Filing gate: ② follow-up of #30349 (scenario library T8, the gallery exporter, draft PR #30930), from the dev report 6684611537. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

**Business reason.** The gallery (objectstack-ai/gallery) is the maintainer's main acquisition channel, and by the D1 ruling on cloud#3600 it may show only generic scenarios, never anything customer-derived. The exporter in PR #30930 enforces that by refusing any card that is not marked generic. No card carries such a marker today, so the exporter exports nothing. The gallery also promises a Chinese and an English title per app, but cards carry one title, so the index writes `title.zh: null`.

## Where (`origin/main`)

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts`: the card schema has no origin field. `provenance` is free prose, and the card's directory is not a marker, because the loader reads any directory, the private overlay included.
- The card title is a single string.
- PR #30930's `src/export/generic.ts`: `NO_GENERIC_MARKER` refuses every card until this lands.

## Wanted

1. A required card field, for example `origin: generic | customer-derived | held-out`. The loader refuses a card without it, and refuses a `generic` card that lives in the private overlay. Set it on all nine open-library cards in `docs/qa/scenarios/`.
2. The card title becomes `{ zh, en }` text, and all nine cards get both.
3. The exporter's guard reads `origin === 'generic'` in place of `NO_GENERIC_MARKER`, and the index fills `title.zh` from the card. If #30930 has landed by then, this is a one-file change there.

Serial: `loader.ts`, `schema.ts` and two cards are in flight in #30846 (#30802). Start after it lands.

**Level:** QA tooling and the scenario card format. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Dedupe (open and closed): "scenario card generic marker origin" and "scenario card title zh en" turned up only #30349 itself and the closed T1a schema card #30289. **New.**

Related: #30349, PR #30930, #30289, #30846.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`, after #30846 lands.
